description: This file, org.apache.commons.math3.random.RandomDataGenerator.java, implements a class that provides various methods to generate random data of different distributions and types, including secure and non-secure random data, with support for reseeding and algorithm configuration. It utilizes external classes like distribution implementations, exceptions, and utility classes.

classes.name: RandomDataGenerator
classes.description: Implements the RandomData interface, providing methods to generate random data of various distributions and types, with support for secure and non-secure modes, reseeding, and algorithm selection.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a random hex string of a specified length using the underlying RandomGenerator.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a pseudorandom integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns a pseudorandom long within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a secure random hex string of a specified length, using SHA-1 hashing.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Returns a secure random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Returns a secure random long within a specified range.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed random number based on the specified mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a Gaussian-distributed random number with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates an exponential-distributed random number with specified mean.

methods.name: nextGamma
methods.description: Generates a gamma-distributed random number with specified shape and scale.

methods.name: nextHypergeometric
methods.description: Samples from a hypergeometric distribution given population size, number of successes, and sample size.

methods.name: nextPascal
methods.description: Samples from a Pascal distribution with specified r and p.

methods.name: nextT
methods.description: Samples from a Student's t distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextWeibull
methods.description: Samples from a Weibull distribution with specified shape and scale.

methods.name: nextZipf
methods.description: Samples from a Zipf distribution with specified number of elements and exponent.

methods.name: nextBeta
methods.description: Samples from a Beta distribution given alpha and beta.

methods.name: nextBinomial
methods.description: Samples from a Binomial distribution given number of trials and probability.

methods.name: nextCauchy
methods.description: Samples from a Cauchy distribution with specified median and scale.

methods.name: nextChiSquare
methods.description: Samples from a Chi-squared distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextF
methods.description: Samples from an F distribution with numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Samples from a uniform distribution between lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Creates a random permutation of k out of n elements.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Samples k elements from a collection.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the non-secure random generator with a specified seed.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator with the current time or a specified seed.

methods.name: setSecureAlgorithm
methods.description: Configures the algorithm and provider for the secure random generator.

methods.name: getRandomGenerator
methods.description: Returns the underlying non-secure RandomGenerator.

methods.name: getSecRan
methods.description: Returns the secure RandomGenerator.
